task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence with three bounded families: repair authored-arena spatial integrity and camera readability, make the ordinary five-wave Bellkeeper route and upgrade transaction closure-ready, and harden the opt-in dense-profile handoff for later eligible-renderer qualification.

diagnosis.root_cause: The authored cemetery integration still has incomplete camera/spatial visibility, the normal five-wave route has only diagnostic progression rather than an ordinary completion proof, and dense qualification is blocked by the current software renderer despite an existing candidate-side profile contract.

stop_conditions: Do not replace, hide, extract, duplicate, or surgically edit the preserved authored cemetery package.
Keep dense profiling opt-in and release-safe; do not claim native qualification while the renderer remains ineligible.
Do not treat deferred godot_mcp_rebind_requested as a candidate disposition; host owns rebind and recapture.

strategy.rationale: Use distinct root-cause strategies: rebase camera/spawn/collision against the intact authored map, repair authoritative route and choice-transaction state together, and harden dense receipts and renderer gating without repeating transform tuning or pretending unavailable native evidence exists.

code: Run focused Godot parser/static checks for the listed camera, world-collision, route, boss, upgrade-draft, and dense-profile files.
Verify the dense self-audit and release guards pass, tester-only actions remain isolated, and no authored-map package surgery or release-default profile enablement was introduced.
runtime: Host/GameLoop Runtime recaptures validate:release_convergence_camera_movement_dash_contract with real horizontal/vertical input, ordinary movement replay, spawn/landmark/perimeter coverage, collision and pause/dash state.

Host/GameLoop Runtime recaptures validate:release_convergence_wave_director_boss_contract from title through five ordinary waves, upgrade selections, Bellkeeper defeat, Result, and clean Retry baselines.

Host/GameLoop Runtime runs the opt-in dense protocol on an eligible renderer for three isolated 1920x1080 cycles, while retaining software-renderer rejection receipts; also reruns validate:host_godot_boot and validate:native_godot_project.
visual: Capture shipped gameplay at spawn, critical route, central building/landmark approach and departure, and perimeter/cardinal views; confirm player, arena, external depth, collision-aligned landmark, and escape lanes remain visible without occlusion drift.

Capture upgrade-draft presentation at native and narrow supported UI scales with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/selection states, truthful current-to-new deltas, silhouettes/icons, and no stacked prose.
Capture Bellkeeper activation/phase/defeat and Result/Retry transitions, plus representative dense-profile gameplay paired with distinct telemetry states.

done_when: The shipped high-angle camera keeps the player, nearby threats, telegraphs, escape lanes, the central building or landmark, and the boundary/perimeter readable during ordinary movement or a movement replay.

The authored map has a larger traversable scale or expanded playable bounds plus coherent external world or external depth beyond the gameplay boundary; the central building/landmark and perimeter have aligned collision with no pass-through, disappearance, or camera occlusion drift.
Dash anticipation, onset, recovery, cooldown, invulnerability, collision sliding, and pause/resume remain statefully inspectable after the framing repair.
tasks.instructions: Repair the camera and authored-world integration around the preserved complete map. Inspect the native streets/terrain, player spawn, camera rig, collision/navigation, landmark occlusion handling, and input-routing owners. Make a real spatial change when extents or framing are insufficient: expand to a larger traversable scale, retain external world depth outside the playable boundary, and align collision at the central building/landmark and perimeter. Verify player and representative enemies cannot pass through, become hidden inside, or cause landmark disappearance during ordinary movement. Keep HUD mouse-filter behavior from blocking movement probes and leave the authored package intact.
tasks.title: Restore arena scale, collision, and camera framing

done_when: A fresh ordinary run advances through five escalating waves, including composition changes and an elite encounter, reaches Bellkeeper activation in wave five, defeats the boss once, reaches Result, and Retry starts a clean run without stale actors, state, audio, pause ownership, or UI.

Automatic combat remains causal throughout the route: legal target selection, attack ownership, damage, death, drops, experience, and upgrade application are reflected in authoritative state without a stalled branch.

The upgrade-draft page leads each of three choices with a recognizable silhouette/icon, compact stat icons, and no more than three truthful current-to-new deltas; it omits unchanged/exhaustive rows and placeholder CURRENT values, and exposes distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, unavailable, selected, and debounced-confirm states.
tasks.instructions: Repair the authoritative wave/run state machine and the real upgrade-draft scene/controller as one ordinary player route. Audit warmup, active waves, upgrade pause/resume, elite warning, Bellkeeper transition/phases/defeat, victory/result, and Retry reset so normal input—not synthetic fixtures—completes all five waves. Preserve deterministic spawn safety, live caps, damage causality, and exactly-once rewards. At each draft, enforce truthful eligibility and stacking, selected-id/rank application before resume, concise visual hierarchy, silhouettes/icons, current-to-new values, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus behavior. Keep any tester preparation separate from advancement, release-guarded, and incapable of qualifying a build by itself.
tasks.title: Complete ordinary route and upgrade-choice transaction

done_when: The candidate exposes an explicit opt-in dense profile with deterministic 25–40 enemy parameters, bounded frame/physics/render and active-entity telemetry, stable sample history, and clean teardown/reset across repeated cycles.

Receipts include requested/resolved/setup_generation/advance_generation/cycle identity, sample availability, lifecycle deltas, runtime-error count, and renderer classification; software rendering is explicitly retained as rejected evidence while an eligible native renderer can qualify three isolated 1920x1080 cycles.

Entering, advancing, exiting, and restarting the profile produces no runaway spawns, orphaned actors, ordinary-balance changes, or new runtime errors, and the profile is unavailable in release exports.
tasks.instructions: Harden the existing candidate dense-profile contract only where needed for a reliable host handoff: keep profile selection explicit and editor-only, preserve deterministic high-entity wave parameters, emit bounded time-series and lifecycle telemetry, and make reset isolation verifiable. Ensure renderer gating occurs after samples are collected so software sessions report useful rejected status rather than masquerading as qualification. Do not tune ordinary waves or alter preserved world presentation, and do not spend candidate work attempting to solve the unavailable external native-renderer collector.
tasks.title: Harden dense-profile qualification handoff
